svg.aria-label: A brass and bone enamel octopus automaton swims on Yves Klein blue, its arms waving. Care is my building language. Writing code is becoming the easy part; deciding what to build, and why, is now the bottleneck. The time AI gives back, I spend on judgment: a clear spec before the build, a measure of whether it worked after, and the honesty to rethink the whole system when the numbers say it is wrong. The models are getting better quickly, which makes taste and care more valuable, not less. Nihan Bayrak: AI specialist, product manager, solutions engineer, Berlin. Below, a year of contributions, 328 in all, as dots that a small octopus walks through and eats. Then three cards: Roundtrip, Conscious Eyes, and Brief to Concept.
svg.title: Nihan Bayrak

svg.aria-label: Contribution graph: 328 contributions in the last year. A small brass octopus walks across it week by week and eats each day's dot; the dots grow back.
svg.title: The year, eaten

svg.aria-label: Pick a card. Three jobs, one person.
svg.title: Pick a card

svg.aria-label: I. Build, ai specialist. Roundtrip. A tester's screenshot goes in. A located, triaged and fixed case comes out. Ask for a demo.
svg.title: Roundtrip

svg.aria-label: II. Ship, product manager. Conscious Eyes. A food and cosmetics scanner that never invents an ingredient. 627 tests stand behind that. Visit the site.
svg.title: Conscious Eyes

svg.aria-label: III. Translate, solutions engineer. Brief to Concept. A raw client packaging brief becomes a design brief, then a first concept image, on one machine. Open the code.
svg.title: Brief to Concept
